about: Skills that are a clear foundation for another skill: a skill listed in `requires` must be learnt before `skill`. Only reviewed entries (reviewed: true, set by a person) are used, by src/game/server/no-regret.js: a skill declining under both scenarios is not put last while a skill still to learn requires it. Only clear foundations belong here; anything debatable is left out.
